title: Saiku UI unit and mocked-browser coverage can be compared by source line

criteria.given: the Saiku UI coverage commands and mocked-browser fixture
criteria.then: unit and browser reports use source paths and record the suite, revision, command, and timestamp

criteria.given: unit and browser LCOV reports from the same revision
criteria.then: the comparison command records each source line's hits from both suites and the documentation explains how to reproduce it
